newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Hollywood-bound reptiles stranded in South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood-bound reptiles stranded in South Africa.

text.p: Hundreds of exotic reptiles bound for Hollywood were stranded at a South African airport and dying of thirst or hunger, officials said on Wednesday.
Animal protection officials seized hundreds of reptiles, including chameleons and lizards, at Johannesburg international airport where they were stranded on their way to the United States.
Many were suffering from thirst or hunger and some had already died, said officials at Pretoria zoo, where the animals were being treated.
The reptiles arrived from Mozambique in crates which were left behind when the rest of the cargo was flown out to the United States on Monday.
It was not clear if the shipments were legal.
